title: Stream Summary: Streamer Interaction and Stream Closure
originalTitle: 【Another Eden】 Chasing the cat once more
lead: The streamer invited the audience to join the next stream, likely in the afternoon, and expressed gratitude for their patience and presence.
summaryOneLine: The streamer invited the audience to join the next stream, likely in the afternoon, and expressed gratitude for their patience and presence.
keyPoints: Invitation to Next Stream and Gratitude
articleBodyHtml:
Invitation to Next Stream and Gratitude

The streamer invited the audience to join the next stream, likely in the afternoon, and expressed gratitude for their patience and presence.

Stream Closure and Goodbye

The streamer said goodbye, mentioned that memberships might be off at the moment, and concluded the stream.

Mention of Regular Breadsticks

The streamer expressed a nostalgic sentiment about missing regular breadsticks.

Streamer's Fatigue and Encouragement to Play the Game

The streamer mentioned sleeping only four hours, planned to take a nap, encouraged viewers to download and play the game, and said goodbye.

relatedStreams.title: 自動編成に任せきらない　IRySが『CookieRun: Kingdom』初見で作ったチーム
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: 自動編成は完成した答えではなく、配置、回復、スキル優先、新キャラへの愛着をプレイヤーが調整する出発点だと分かる

relatedStreams.title: IRySが「ゆるホロチームカート」で初の1位　16人で走った年末の『マリオカート ワールド』
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: IRySが16人参加の「#ゆるホロチームカート」で『マリオカート ワールド』に挑戦。個人戦で自身初という1位を獲得し、チーム戦や雑談を経て新春ゲーム祭の告知まで進んだ。
